==Overview==
=== Format ===
* Two groups of six teams each
* Groups based on [[2015 LPL/Summer/Regular Season|Summer 2015]] and [[2015 Season China Regional Finals|2015 Regional Finals]] performances
** One team from Tier 1 ([[LGD Gaming]] and [[EDward Gaming]])
** Two teams from Tier 2 ([[Qiao Gu Reapers]], [[Invictus Gaming]], [[Snake eSports]], and [[Vici Gaming]])
** Two teams from Tier 3 ([[Oh My God]], [[Masters 3]], [[Team WE]], and [[Royal Never Give Up]])
** One team from Tier 4 ([[Hyper Youth Gaming]] and [[Energy Pacemaker.All]])
* Each team plays 16 matches.
** Double Round Robin within own group
** Single Round Robin against other group
* Best of 3
* Top 4 from each group qualifies to the [[LPL/2016 Season/Spring Playoffs|playoffs]]
* Group winners receive playoff byes into the semifinals
* Second place teams receive playoff byes into the quarterfinals
* Fifth and sixth-place teams play in [[LPL/2016 Season/Summer Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]]
